rv.q: It's a cartoon, but one that delivers sly thrusts to the brain and solar plexus alongside the laughs.

Danny Kapinos' playful and powerful production will make audiences laugh at the preposterous plot while pondering how this futuristic fantasy potently portrays the politics and ecological concerns of today.
The satire is the boss here, and everyone in the theatre becomes a part of it.

cn.t: Critics praise Theo Ubique's energetic, immersive production of the satirical musical, highlighting sharp humor, strong vocals, and inventive cabaret-style staging that engages audiences in the dystopian comedy.
